systems.name: database
systems.why: The customers and their renewal dates are kept there.

systems.name: mail
systems.why: Each reminder goes to a customer by email.

systems.name: text-reasoning
systems.capability: text: a short, plain reminder in the customer's own terms
systems.why: Writing each reminder so it reads as a person wrote it is a judgment.

kind.why: A short program with one judgment: read, write each reminder, send. A harness reading skills carries it.

speed.limit: a whole list sent within 600 seconds
speed.why: A list of a few hundred customers is one pass.

data.limit: reads names, emails and renewal dates; keeps nothing between runs; never sends the list anywhere but the mail sender
data.why: Customer data stays in the organization's own database.

trust.limit: takes the run only from its owner
trust.why: Sending email to customers is the organization's voice.

formats.convention: a header `sent, skipped`, then `## Sent` and `## Skipped` with one bullet per customer and why
formats.why: A person reads what went out.
The owner says which renewals are due, in words.

settings.name: days-before
settings.label: Days before renewal
settings.about: How many days before a renewal the reminder goes.
settings.why: How far ahead of a renewal a reminder goes is the organization's habit; two weeks is common.

decisions.decided: Code walks the list, and the model writes only each reminder
decisions.context: Every run is the same: read the due customers, write each reminder, send it.
decisions.why: One model call per customer bounds the spend and lets each step be tested.

alternatives.option: A model that reads the list and decides whom to email
alternatives.why_not: what it sends and spends would not be bounded

consequences: The job is control script, intelligence called and contract full.

decisions.context: A person reads what went out.
consequences: Its headings are fixed so a test can hold them.

skills.name: renewal-reminders
skills.responsibility: Emails each customer whose renewal is due a short reminder, and reports the run.
skills.script: Reads the due customers, has each reminder written, sends it, and writes the run's account.

parts.name: customer reader
parts.responsibility: Reads the names, emails and renewal dates of the customers whose renewal is due.

parts.name: reminder writer
parts.responsibility: Has the model write each reminder in the customer's own terms, through the shared model caller.

parts.name: mail sender
parts.responsibility: Sends each reminder to its customer and notes what went out.

parts.name: account writer
parts.responsibility: Writes the run's account under Sent and Skipped.

flow.says: The owner says which renewals are due.

flow.data: which customers to remind and days-before
flow.says: The harness starts the script with the job and the setting as flags.
The reader reads the due customers.

flow.data: each customer's name and renewal date
flow.says: The writer asks the model for one short reminder.
The sender mails each reminder to its customer.
The account goes back as the reply, through the harness.
